confirmed_findings.title: Draft vehicle binding never retires, including after successful save
confirmed_findings.mechanism: The only setter after initialization runs when the bound vehicle is null. Cancel only toggles visibility; success only closes the form. No reset/new-draft action clears the binding. The guard correctly prevents wrong-vehicle writes but strands later creation on another selected vehicle while this page remains mounted.

Binding is still 7, Vehicle 7 is shown, Save is disabled and submit returns. Preserve the original retained cross-selection draft when fixing lifetime.

confirmed_findings.title: Clearing a required price synthesizes a known zero
confirmed_findings.mechanism: MoneyInput emits null for blank/invalid numeric input. Page substitutes 0 and feeds it back into the required controlled field, so a blank required fact becomes a priced zero. Deliberately entering zero is a different case.
confirmed_findings.source_only_repro: Trace event.target.value="": MoneyInput next=null, page callback sets price_minor=0, next render/hint shows zero. A hypothetical later draft payload contains 0 rather than requiring an explicit price. No submit performed.

confirmed_findings.title: Fractional-minor benchmark rates are displayed as zero currency
confirmed_findings.mechanism: A per-unit rate accepts step="any" but display first rounds to two fractional minor digits, then the amount formatter limits currency fraction digits to its exponent. Valid nonzero fractional rates can display as zero. Filter key remains raw, so distinct rates share zero display labels.
confirmed_findings.source_only_repro: Hypothetical USD 0.1 minor/unit -> major 0.001 -> two currency digits $0.00. A 0.001 minor/unit rate becomes 0 already in the page pre-rounding. Source algebra only, not an executed financial calculation.

confirmed_findings.title: Business date inputs silently mean UTC midnight
confirmed_findings.mechanism: toDateInput slices UTC ISO day; fromDateInput serializes UTC midnight. Started/Ended labels do not disclose this basis, while register renders local instants. These are independent business dates, not workspace ranges.
